title: Animals at Night
author: Tadoku Note (original)
summary: わたしたちが眠っている夜に、起きて活動する動物たちがいます。フクロウ、コウモリ、ホタルなど、夜の動物をやさしく紹介。

source.note: Original text written for this app. General information only.

paragraphs: At night, we go to bed. We close our eyes and sleep. But many animals do not sleep at night. They wake up when the sun goes down. They look for food in the dark. These animals are called nocturnal animals.

Why do some animals like the night? There are many reasons. At night, it is cool. In hot places, the day is too hot for some animals. Also, at night, it is easy to hide. Big animals cannot see small animals in the dark.
But how do nocturnal animals find food in the dark? They have special eyes, ears and noses.

Owls are birds of the night. They have very big eyes. They can see well when there is very little light. They also have very good ears. An owl can hear a small mouse under the snow! Owls fly very quietly. The mouse does not hear the owl. Then it is too late.

Bats fly at night, too. But bats do not use their eyes very much. They use sound. A bat makes a very high sound. We cannot hear it. The sound hits an insect and comes back to the bat. Then the bat knows, “There is an insect. It is there!” A bat can eat hundreds of insects in one night.

Cats are good in the dark, too. Look at a cat’s eyes at night. They are very big and round. In the day, they are thin. Big eyes take in more light. Cats also have long hairs on their faces. These hairs help them feel things in the dark.

Some animals make their own light! Fireflies are small insects. Their bodies make a yellow or green light. They turn the light on and off. They do this to talk to other fireflies. In summer in Japan, many people go to rivers at night to see them.
Some animals in the sea make light, too. Deep in the ocean, it is always dark, day and night. Many fish there have small lights on their bodies.

Some nocturnal animals live near people. Raccoons come into towns at night. They open garbage cans and look for food. Foxes walk in city parks. Hedgehogs eat insects in gardens. Many people never see them, because they are asleep!
Tonight, go outside and be very quiet. Listen. Maybe you can hear an owl. Maybe you can see a bat in the sky. The night is not empty. It is full of life.
